Report_ID: ADAS-cog/11 change from baseline at week 26 (6 months)
Title: Galantamine Prolonged-Release Formulation in the Treatment of Mild to Moderate Alzheimer's Disease
Author: Brodaty
Comment: Fig. 2 reports mean change ± SE (SEM), not SD — recorded in group_*_se fields as reported. M_diff (-3.1) is the raw between-group difference galantamine minus placebo computed from the two explicitly reported OC mean changes (-1.8 vs 1.3), matching the direction of the paper's own reported 95% CI (-4.17 to -2.08); negative favours galantamine because lower ADAS-cog = better, so the sign must be reversed for the plan's positive-favours-treatment convention. SE_diff was derived from the paper's reported 95% CI as (−2.08 − (−4.17))/3.92 = 0.533. p-value reported as "p < 0.001" and entered as 0.001 (upper bound). The prolonged-release (PRC) arm shares this placebo group and was deliberately NOT extracted per the synthesis plan, to avoid double-counting the shared placebo.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Galantamine immediate-release 8 or 12 mg twice daily (16 or 24 mg/day)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); treatment SD derived from its reported SE (SD = SE * sqrt(n)); control SD derived from its reported SE (SD = SE * sqrt(n))
Design Type: randomized controlled trial (double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled, parallel-group)
Country: USA, Australia, Canada, South Africa, New Zealand
Participant type: Patients with mild to moderate probable Alzheimer's disease (NINCDS-ADRDA criteria; screening MMSE 10-24; ADAS-cog/11 >=18)
Recruitment source: 93 multicenter psychiatry, neurology and geriatric offices and clinics (66 US, 11 Australia, 9 Canada, 6 South Africa, 1 New Zealand)
Outcome measurement: Mean change from baseline (± SE) in ADAS-cog/11 score at week 26, observed cases

additional_group_ns: Excluded third arm (not part of this dose subgroup): galantamine PRC 16 or 24 mg/day once daily, n = 240 observed cases at week 26 (OC mean change -1.4 ± 0.34); randomized n = 320, treated n = 319
